test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 1) Mid-Range Full Test - 04
subject: general
question:
The statements below are followed by two conclusions labeled I and II. Assuming that the information in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with generally established facts, decide which conclusion(s) logically and definitely follow(s) from the information given in the statements.

**Statements:**

1) Some monks are convicts.

2) Some convicts are soldiers.

**Conclusion:**

I. Some convicts are monks.

II. Some soldiers are convicts.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor conclusion II follows.

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4ca90ecb3fa776b06e332a1298836cd2a6cc0a42020f481e3ba96af38fe533cc.png] 

I. Some convicts are monks. → True (As, Some monks are convicts → so, some convicts are monks)

II. Some soldiers are convicts. → True (As, Some convicts are soldiers → so, some soldiers are convicts)

Hence, both conclusions follow.
